page.overview:
Who is Frank Dochnal?

Frank J. Dochnal (October 8, 1920 - July 7, 2010) was a driver from St. Louis, Missouri. He raced parttime in addition to working as a mechanic. He made one attempt to qualify for the 1963 Mexican Grand Prix in an older , but withdrew after a practice accident damaged the car beyond the ability to repair it before the race.

Dochnal later worked as an engineer for Howard Hughes, and was a tech official for USAC.
